draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and steady, planning the upcoming days
notes: Takes the classifier 个 (gè), e.g., 一个星期 (one week).
Followed by numbers 1 to 6 to name Monday through Saturday (星期一 to 星期六), and by 天 or 日 for Sunday (星期天, 星期日).

examples.translation: I went to Beijing last week.
examples.emotion: nostalgic and reminiscent, recalling a past trip

draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and steady, planning the upcoming days
notes: 星期 (xīngqī) is commonly used to talk about the days of the week, often paired with numbers from 1 to 6 (e.g., 星期一 for Monday).
For Sunday, you can use 星期天 (xīngqītiān) or 星期日 (xīngqīrì), though 星期天 is slightly more common in everyday speech.
